disqualifier.note: Wrapped default-false includeInferred plus optional inference payload. The tool path writes Some iff the flag is true, but the workbench copies a cached inference Option while setting includeInferred from the inferred-view atom, so false+Some is legal. Readers AND the pair; not a masked union.

retryable is an independent retry-policy fact; disconnectReason is an optional classification that may be none even when retryable is true. Tests construct retryable true and false with no reason. Not flag-duplicating payload presence.

NullOr boolean next to NullOr text. searchText emits t.truncated with text forced NULL; getDocument can emit truncated true with a substr text still present. Truncation and text presence are independent wire columns, not a masked union.
Budget-truncation flag plus optional annotation string. Handlers write truncated from row-fit independently of whether note is present; both-false, truncated-only, and mixed pairs are legal.

Single boolean projected from GraphPartition via isExcludedFromReasoning at the only write site. Not parallel booleans: asserted/ontologies write false, inferred/shapes/provenance write true. The enum is the state variable.

Single BoolKeyDefaultFalse Illinois Rule 23 -U parse marker. The suffix is stripped from documentNumber, which remains present either way. court vs database exclusivity is optional strings, not sibling booleans. Independently observed eyecite fact.

Single BoolKeyDefaultFalse parse marker for a trailing et seq. subsection/year/publisher remain independently optional locators; tests set hasEtSeq true without those payloads. Not flag-duplicating presence.
Same single default-false et-seq parse marker as StatuteCitation on the regulation shape. No sibling boolean; edition locators are independent Option fields.
Single config toggle choosing fullSpan vs core span; space is a tagged union and contextLength is a numeric default. Not parallel booleans.
optionalKey(S.Boolean) render mark for the first row. rows is always present; header vs body is an independent table display fact, not a payload-presence flag.
Single optional prop defaulted to false in the destructure. No sibling boolean on the props; waiting is projected from the host AsyncResult into this one gate.
Single BoolKeyDefaultFalse request flag to bypass the cached mirror probe. No sibling boolean; workspaceId is the only other field.
Wire twin of VaultSyncStatusInput.forceProbe on the RPC payload. Same single default-false request flag; not a parallel cluster with connected on the status result.
Wrapped default-false query option on the tool request. Converted to Option<inference> at the service boundary; this struct itself has no sibling boolean or payload the flag duplicates.
Same wrapped default-false includeInferred on the SHACL tool request. validateSession maps it to inference Option on RunOntologyValidationInput; one request flag, not 2^n boolean creep.
